description: This file defines a ViewModel (HomeViewModel) for a smart home TV control app. It manages the in-memory state of various devices, allowing toggling their power states. It also defines a data class (DeviceItem) representing individual devices with unique IDs, names, and on/off states.

classes.name: DeviceItem
classes.description: Data class representing a device with a unique ID, name, and power state.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing a list of device states and providing functionality to toggle individual devices.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the power state of a device identified by its ID.
